[color=155,155,155,255]Humans were the most common being in the world once, but these days are long gone. The population decimated by constant wars is now just a shadow of its former glory. Their center of power is in the Black Pyramid of Sareth where God Pharaoh Sandaver rules over the dead. The power that allows these beings to defy death is shrouded in mystery.[/color]

Intelligence +2, Willpower +2
Thirst and hunger is replaced by life essence.
Death aura dealing 1 death damage to everything nearby every turn.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. They live deep in the jungles of Tar'Var. They are individuals, loners and prefer seclusion over contact with others, as they considering other races untrustworthy. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Strength +1, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

[color=155,155,155,255]A long time ago dark elves were living in the forests with their brethren, but they were corrupted by dark gods. Now they occupy huge underground cities. race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Vampires are dead beings of living races, cursed to wander the world till the end of times. They don't eat regular food and don't drink water. Vampires have formed an enclave in the ruins of Black Sun Castle, where they scheme to take over the world and enslave the living like cattle.[/color]

Thirst and hunger is replaced by bloodlust.

[color=142,39,194,255]Life Essence[/color] defines how much the character is lacking essence to sustain itself. If life essence drops below 0, the dehydration level will increase, and life essence level will start falling from 100 again. You can regain life essence by dealing death damage to anything that can receive it. Receiving holy damage will reduce life essence gathered!

[color=60,60,60,255]Mortality[/color] level decreases the chance of successful attacks and many other actions by 10%. If the dehydration level reaches 10, the character will die.
PTBR:
[color=142,39,194,255]Essência Vital[/color] define quanto o personagem carece de essência para se sustentar. Se a essência vital cair abaixo de 0, o nível de desidratação aumentará, e o nível de essência vital começará a cair de 100 novamente. Você pode recuperar essência vital causando dano de morte a qualquer coisa que possa recebê-lo. Receber dano sagrado reduzirá a essência vital acumulada!

[color=60,60,60,255]Mortalidade[/color] nível diminui a chance de ataques bem-sucedidos e muitas outras ações em 10%. Se o nível de desidratação atingir 10, o personagem morrerá.

Vampires have formed an enclave in the ruins of Black Sun Castle, where they scheme to take over the world and enslave the living like cattle.[/color]

Thirst and hunger is replaced by bloodlust.
Infravision: see in the dark.

Trolls have the strength to tear smaller beings apart in the blink of an eye. They are forever hungry and possess very potent regenerative powers.[/color]

Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2
Regenerates health 20% faster.
Gets hungry 50% faster.

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Club
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Club
race.name: Troll

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Orcs are green. Orcs are mean. Orcs want to smash, bash and eat. They form hordes led by the most brutal chieftains of their kind to raid other races for loot. Their physical appearance is second only to trolls and giants.[/color]

Strength +2, Endurance +2
Hit bonus +1 on all weapons

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Hand axe
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Hatchet
race.name: Orc

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Liches are powerful mages that cheated death. There are not many of them in the world, but most are immensely powerful. Their center of power is in the Black Pyramid of Sareth where God Pharaoh Sandaver rules over the dead. The power that allows these beings to defy death is shrouded in mystery.[/color]

Intelligence +2, Willpower +2
Thirst and hunger is replaced by life essence.
Death aura dealing 1 death damage to everything nearby every turn.

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Quarterstaff
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Mask
race.name: Lich

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. They live deep in the jungles of Tar'Var. They are individuals, loners and prefer seclusion over contact with others, as they considering other races untrustworthy. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Strength +1, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Dagger

Dexterity +2, Intelligence +1, Willpower +1

EN:
Potential determines the maximum level of a skill. You may unlock your potential by training with someone who's more skilled than you.

The sum of all skills potential is the potential of your character and it cannot go over [color=125,200,125,255]{}[/color] right now. As your character reaches middle aged stage for your chosen race, you may unlock additional potential.

You may not reduce your potential after training, so choose your path wisely.
PTBR:
O potencial determina o nível máximo de uma habilidade. Você pode desbloquear seu potencial treinando com alguém mais habilidoso que você.

A soma do potencial de todas as habilidades é o potencial do seu personagem e não pode ultrapassar [color=125,200,125,255]{}[/color] no momento. Quando seu personagem atingir a fase de meia-idade para a raça escolhida, você poderá desbloquear potencial adicional.

Você não pode reduzir seu potencial após o treinamento, então escolha seu caminho com sabedoria.

[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Infravision: see in the dark.

EN:
Like to do your thing with little consequence? Want to explore the world at your own pace? Build a hut in the forest while the world around you burns to the ground? This game mode is for you.

- Drops all items from backpack and respawns in home settlement after death.
- Your character doesn't age.
- Your character can't die from starvation or dehydration.
- Skills require 200% more effort to advance.
- You can only begin as an orphan.
- Scoring disabled.
PTBR:
Gosta de fazer do seu jeito com poucas consequências? Quer explorar o mundo no seu ritmo? Construir uma cabana na floresta enquanto o mundo ao redor arde? Este modo de jogo é para você.

- Solta todos os itens da mochila e renasce no assentamento de origem após a morte.
- Seu personagem não envelhece.
- Seu personagem não pode morrer de fome ou sede.
- Habilidades exigem 200% mais esforço para avançar.
- Você só pode começar como órfão.
- Pontuação desativada.

Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2
Regenerates health 20% faster.
Gets hungry 50% faster.

[color=155,155,155,255]Liches are powerful mages that cheated death. There are not many of them in the world, but most are immensely powerful. Thirst and hunger is replaced by life essence.
Death aura dealing 1 death damage to everything nearby every turn.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Strength +1, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

EN:
Sneaking allows characters to walk quietly, unheard by nearby beings, but it does not have any effect if they remain in the line of sight.

Sneaking attempt is performed automatically when walking, and its chance of success is determined by distance from every being and their opposing hearing checks.

Sneaking may also determine if you get noticed while pickpocketing, robbing, and stealing.
PTBR:
Furtividade permite que personagens andem silenciosamente, sem serem ouvidos por seres próximos, mas não tem efeito se permanecerem na linha de visão.

A tentativa de furtividade é realizada automaticamente ao andar, e sua chance de sucesso é determinada pela distância de cada ser e seus testes de audição opostos.

A furtividade também pode determinar se você é notado ao praticar furto de bolso, roubo e furto.

EN:
Hit property improves the chance to hit an opponent when performing a basic attack and is an opposite property to Parry.

Hit check is performed as follows:
[color=255,246,143,255](Hit + 1d10) / (Parry + 1d10) = Chance to Hit %[/color]
Minimum chance to hit is 10%. The visible range is between all your equipped weapons' minimum and maximum hit values.
PTBR:
A propriedade Acerto melhora a chance de atingir um oponente ao realizar um ataque básico e é uma propriedade oposta a Aparar.

A verificação de acerto é realizada da seguinte forma:
[color=255,246,143,255](Acerto + 1d10) / (Aparar + 1d10) = Chance de Acerto %[/color]
A chance mínima de acerto é 10%. O intervalo visível fica entre os valores mínimo e máximo de acerto de todas as suas armas equipadas.

EN:
Parry property improves the chance to avoid getting hit by an opponent during a basic attack and is an opposite property to Hit. Abilities cannot be parried.

Hit check is performed as follows:
[color=255,246,143,255](Hit + 1d10) / (Parry + 1d10) = Chance to Hit %[/color]
Max chance to parry is 90%.

Parry can occur only 1 (2 with shield) times between attacks, which means performing your attack resets the counter. Both abilities that deal damage and regular attacks reset the counter, and drawing blood is unnecessary.
PTBR:
A propriedade Aparar melhora a chance de evitar ser atingido por um oponente durante um ataque básico e é uma propriedade oposta a Acerto. Habilidades não podem ser aparadas.

A verificação de acerto é realizada da seguinte forma:
[color=255,246,143,255](Acerto + 1d10) / (Aparar + 1d10) = Chance de Acerto %[/color]
A chance máxima de aparar é 90%.

Aparar pode ocorrer apenas 1 vezes (2 com escudo) entre ataques, o que significa que realizar seu ataque reinicia o contador. Tanto habilidades que causam dano quanto ataques regulares reiniciam o contador, e causar sangramento é desnecessário.

race.name: Rasimi

EN:
Resistances cover specific areas of your body and reduce damage received from different sources. There are four major areas where you can get hit, and for each of these locations, only some of the items you wear provide cover.

[color=255,246,143,255]Head (16%)[/color] - covered by items in [color=215,206,123,255]head cloth[/color], [color=215,206,123,255]head armor[/color], and [color=215,206,123,255]amulet[/color] slots.
[color=255,246,143,255]Torso (36%)[/color] - covered by items in [color=215,206,123,255]torso cloth[/color], [color=215,206,123,255]torso armor[/color], [color=215,206,123,255]belt[/color], and [color=215,206,123,255]cloak[/color] slots. 
[color=255,246,143,255]Arms (28%)[/color] - covered by items in [color=215,206,123,255]gloves[/color] and [color=215,206,123,255]both ring[/color] slots.
[color=255,246,143,255]Legs (20%)[/color] - covered by items in [color=215,206,123,255]legs cloth[/color], [color=215,206,123,255]legs armor[/color], and [color=215,206,123,255]boots[/color] slots.

Additionally, wielding a [color=215,206,123,255]shield[/color] in the offhand slot provides resistance to each location mentioned above.

Each resistance point reduces the damage of the corresponding type by 1 point up to minimum damage value.
[color=215,206,123,255]Minimum damage[/color] depends on [color=215,206,123,255]combat disadventage[/color]: attacks from the front deals min. of [color=255,246,143,255]10%[/color] of rolled damage, flanking attacks [color=255,246,143,255]20%[/color] and backstabbing attacks as much as [color=255,246,143,255]30%[/color].

Damage dealt by [color=215,206,123,255]weather[/color] and [color=215,206,123,255]environment conditions[/color] can be reduced to 0 damage by resistance, ignoring minimum damage.
PTBR:
Resistências cobrem áreas específicas do seu corpo e reduzem o dano recebido de diferentes fontes. Existem quatro áreas principais onde você pode ser atingido, e para cada uma dessas localizações, apenas alguns dos itens que você usa fornecem cobertura.

[color=255,246,143,255]Cabeça (16%)[/color] - coberta por itens nos espaços de [color=215,206,123,255]tecido de cabeça[/color], [color=215,206,123,255]armadura de cabeça[/color] e [color=215,206,123,255]amuleto[/color].
[color=255,246,143,255]Torso (36%)[/color] - coberto por itens nos espaços de [color=215,206,123,255]tecido de torso[/color], [color=215,206,123,255]armadura de torso[/color], [color=215,206,123,255]cinto[/color] e [color=215,206,123,255]manto[/color].
[color=255,246,143,255]Braços (28%)[/color] - cobertos por itens nos espaços de [color=215,206,123,255]luvas[/color] e [color=215,206,123,255]ambos os anéis[/color].
[color=255,246,143,255]Pernas (20%)[/color] - cobertas por itens nos espaços de [color=215,206,123,255]tecido de pernas[/color], [color=215,206,123,255]armadura de pernas[/color] e [color=215,206,123,255]botas[/color].

Além disso, empunhar um [color=215,206,123,255]escudo[/color] no espaço de mão secundária fornece resistência a cada localização mencionada acima.

Cada ponto de resistência reduz o dano do tipo correspondente em 1 ponto até o valor mínimo de dano.
[color=215,206,123,255]Dano mínimo[/color] depende de [color=215,206,123,255]desvantagem em combate[/color]: ataques de frente causam mínimo de [color=255,246,143,255]10%[/color] do dano rolado, ataques de flanco [color=255,246,143,255]20%[/color] e ataques pelas costas tanto quanto [color=255,246,143,255]30%[/color].

Dano causado por [color=215,206,123,255]clima[/color] e [color=215,206,123,255]condições ambientais[/color] pode ser reduzido a 0 de dano pela resistência, ignorando o dano mínimo.

Their greed pushes them to challenge dwarves for their territory constantly. From time to time, they organize in hordes that swarm even the human empire.[/color]

Dexterity +3, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Sneaking +10

race.name: Goblin

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]A long time ago dark elves were living in the forests with their brethren, but they were corrupted by dark gods. Now they occupy huge underground cities. Their controversial religious practices and rituals make them feared and dreaded. They despise most other races for opposing their rightful place among them.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Intelligence +1, Willpower +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Sight range +1

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Vampires are dead beings of living races, cursed to wander the world till the end of times. They don't eat regular food and don't drink water. They feed by drinking the blood of the living to sustain their immortal bodies. Vampires have formed an enclave in the ruins of Black Sun Castle, where they scheme to take over the world and enslave the living like cattle.[/color]

Strength +1, Endurance +2, Intelligence +1
Thirst and hunger is replaced by bloodlust.
Infravision: see in the dark.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Trolls are huge humanoid beasts. Not many beings of this race are considered smart, but they make up for it with brutal, physical power. Trolls have the strength to tear smaller beings apart in the blink of an eye. They are forever hungry and possess very potent regenerative powers.[/color]

Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2
Regenerates health 20% faster.
Gets hungry 50% faster.

[color=155,155,155,255]Orcs are green. Orcs are mean. Orcs want to smash, bash and eat. They form hordes led by the most brutal chieftains of their kind to raid other races for loot. Their physical appearance is second only to trolls and giants.[/color]

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Liches are powerful mages that cheated death. There are not many of them in the world, but most are immensely powerful. Their center of power is in the Black Pyramid of Sareth where God Pharaoh Sandaver rules over the dead. The power that allows these beings to defy death is shrouded in mystery.[/color]

Thirst and hunger is replaced by life essence.
Death aura dealing 1 death damage to everything nearby every turn.

[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. Trolls have the strength to tear smaller beings apart in the blink of an eye. They are forever hungry and possess very potent regenerative powers.[/color]

Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2
Regenerates health 20% faster.
Gets hungry 50% faster.

Trolls have the strength to tear smaller beings apart in the blink of an eye. They are forever hungry and possess very potent regenerative powers.[/color]

Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2
Regenerates health 20% faster.
Gets hungry 50% faster.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Orcs are green. Orcs are mean. Orcs want to smash, bash and eat. They form hordes led by the most brutal chieftains of their kind to raid other races for loot. Their physical appearance is second only to trolls and giants.[/color]

Strength +2, Endurance +2

[color=155,155,155,255]Liches are powerful mages that cheated death. There are not many of them in the world, but most are immensely powerful. Their center of power is in the Black Pyramid of Sareth where God Pharaoh Sandaver rules over the dead. The power that allows these beings to defy death is shrouded in mystery.[/color]

Thirst and hunger is replaced by life essence.
Death aura dealing 1 death damage to everything nearby every turn.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. They live deep in the jungles of Tar'Var. They are individuals, loners and prefer seclusion over contact with others, as they considering other races untrustworthy. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Strength +1, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

[color=155,155,155,255]Trolls are huge humanoid beasts. Not many beings of this race are considered smart, but they make up for it with brutal, physical power. Trolls have the strength to tear smaller beings apart in the blink of an eye. They are forever hungry and possess very potent regenerative powers.[/color]

Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2
Regenerates health 20% faster.
Gets hungry 50% faster.

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Club
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Club
race.name: Troll

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Orcs are green. Orcs are mean. Orcs want to smash, bash and eat. They form hordes led by the most brutal chieftains of their kind to raid other races for loot. Their physical appearance is second only to trolls and giants.[/color]

Strength +2, Endurance +2
Hit bonus +1 on all weapons

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Hand axe
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Hatchet
race.name: Orc

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Liches are powerful mages that cheated death. There are not many of them in the world, but most are immensely powerful. Their center of power is in the Black Pyramid of Sareth where God Pharaoh Sandaver rules over the dead. The power that allows these beings to defy death is shrouded in mystery.[/color]

Intelligence +2, Willpower +2
Thirst and hunger is replaced by life essence.
Death aura dealing 1 death damage to everything nearby every turn.

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Quarterstaff
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Mask
race.name: Lich

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. They live deep in the jungles of Tar'Var. They are individuals, loners and prefer seclusion over contact with others, as they considering other races untrustworthy. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Strength +1, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Dagger, Shirt
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Dagger
race.name: Rasimi

EN:
Movement Speed is the time in turns that takes to make a move to a nearby tile. Higher value means the movement is slower.

The speed can be affected by items, abilities or terrain.

Minimum Movement Speed is 0.1.
PTBR:
A Velocidade de Movimento é o tempo em turnos que leva para mover-se para um tile adjacente. Valores maiores indicam movimento mais lento.

A velocidade pode ser afetada por itens, habilidades ou terreno.

A Velocidade de Movimento mínima é 0.1.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Humans were the most common being in the world once, but these days are long gone. The population decimated by constant wars is now just a shadow of its former glory. Representatives of this race are extremely adaptable to the situation, but their history was marked heavily by external influence. As the War of Worlds has ended, a great empire has been formed, where single human family clings to the seat of power to this day.[/color]

All statistics +1
Gets hungry 50% slower

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Knife, Bandage
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Fishing rod
race.name: Human

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Dark dwarves are a subrace of dwarves completely corrupted by greed. They prefer to build their incredible keeps very deep below the ground or near volcanoes. Beings of these race are known for being cruel and malevolent.[/color]

Endurance +2
Willpower +2
Infravision: see in the dark.
Tinkerer: double chance to learn new recipe when salvaging.

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Pickaxe, Belt
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Pickaxe
race.name: Dark dwarf

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Goblins are small greenskin creatures known for their ruthlessness. Some say they are shorter orc cousins. They form tribes and prefer to live in the mountains. Their greed pushes them to challenge dwarves for their territory constantly. From time to time, they organize in hordes that swarm even the human empire.[/color]

Dexterity +3, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Sneaking +10

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Rags
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Rags
race.name: Goblin

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]A long time ago dark elves were living in the forests with their brethren, but they were corrupted by dark gods. Now they occupy huge underground cities. Their controversial religious practices and rituals make them feared and dreaded. They despise most other races for opposing their rightful place among them.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Intelligence +1, Willpower +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Sight range +1

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Dagger
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Short bow

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Vampires are dead beings of living races, cursed to wander the world till the end of times. They don't eat regular food and don't drink water. They feed by drinking the blood of the living to sustain their immortal bodies. Vampires have formed an enclave in the ruins of Black Sun Castle, where they scheme to take over the world and enslave the living like cattle.[/color]

Strength +1, Endurance +2, Intelligence +1
Thirst and hunger is replaced by bloodlust.
Infravision: see in the dark.

Their center of power is in the Black Pyramid of Sareth where God Pharaoh Sandaver rules over the dead. The power that allows these beings to defy death is shrouded in mystery.[/color]

Intelligence +2, Willpower +2
Thirst and hunger is replaced by life essence.
Death aura dealing 1 death damage to everything nearby every turn.

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Quarterstaff
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Mask
race.name: Lich

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. They live deep in the jungles of Tar'Var. They are individuals, loners and prefer seclusion over contact with others, as they considering other races untrustworthy. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Strength +1, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Dagger, Shirt
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Dagger
race.name: Rasimi

EN:
Characters in Soulash 2 are shaped by the skills they use. Each has a maximum potential that will allow you to master up to 5 skills, or mix and combine them without full mastery.

If this is your first playthrough, it's recommended to pick [color=244,247,118,255]Adventuring[/color] skill with a [color=244,247,118,255]Knife[/color] and at least one weapon or magic combat ability to deal with dangers while exploring the world.
PTBR:
Personagens em Soulash 2 são moldados pelas habilidades que usam. Cada um tem um potencial máximo que permitirá dominar até 5 habilidades, ou misturá-las e combiná-las sem domínio total.

Se esta é sua primeira partida, recomenda-se escolher a habilidade [color=244,247,118,255]Aventureiro[/color] com uma [color=244,247,118,255]Faca[/color] e pelo menos uma habilidade de combate com arma ou magia para lidar com perigos ao explorar o mundo.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Vampires are dead beings of living races, cursed to wander the world till the end of times. They don't eat regular food and don't drink water. They live deep in the jungles of Tar'Var. They are individuals, loners and prefer seclusion over contact with others, as they considering other races untrustworthy. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Strength +1, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

[color=155,155,155,255]Dark dwarves are a subrace of dwarves completely corrupted by greed. They prefer to build their incredible keeps very deep below the ground or near volcanoes. Beings of these race are known for being cruel and malevolent.[/color]

Endurance +2
Willpower +2
Infravision: see in the dark.
Tinkerer: double chance to learn new recipe when salvaging.

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Pickaxe, Belt
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Pickaxe
race.name: Dark dwarf

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Goblins are small greenskin creatures known for their ruthlessness. Some say they are shorter orc cousins. They form tribes and prefer to live in the mountains. Their greed pushes them to challenge dwarves for their territory constantly. From time to time, they organize in hordes that swarm even the human empire.[/color]

Dexterity +3, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Sneaking +10

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Rags
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Rags
race.name: Goblin

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]A long time ago dark elves were living in the forests with their brethren, but they were corrupted by dark gods. Now they occupy huge underground cities. Their controversial religious practices and rituals make them feared and dreaded. They despise most other races for opposing their rightful place among them.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Intelligence +1, Willpower +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Sight range +1

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Dagger
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Short bow
race.name: Dark elf

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Vampires are dead beings of living races, cursed to wander the world till the end of times. They don't eat regular food and don't drink water. They feed by drinking the blood of the living to sustain their immortal bodies. Vampires have formed an enclave in the ruins of Black Sun Castle, where they scheme to take over the world and enslave the living like cattle.[/color]

Strength +1, Endurance +2, Intelligence +1
Thirst and hunger is replaced by bloodlust.
Infravision: see in the dark.

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Cloak, Hood
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Cloak
race.name: Vampire

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Trolls are huge humanoid beasts. Not many beings of this race are considered smart, but they make up for it with brutal, physical power. Trolls have the strength to tear smaller beings apart in the blink of an eye. They are forever hungry and possess very potent regenerative powers.[/color]

Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2
Regenerates health 20% faster.
Gets hungry 50% faster.

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Club
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Club
race.name: Troll

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Orcs are green. Orcs are mean. Orcs want to smash, bash and eat. They form hordes led by the most brutal chieftains of their kind to raid other races for loot. Their physical appearance is second only to trolls and giants.[/color]

Strength +2, Endurance +2
Hit bonus +1 on all weapons

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Hand axe
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Hatchet
race.name: Orc

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Liches are powerful mages that cheated death. There are not many of them in the world, but most are immensely powerful. Their center of power is in the Black Pyramid of Sareth where God Pharaoh Sandaver rules over the dead. The power that allows these beings to defy death is shrouded in mystery.[/color]

Intelligence +2, Willpower +2
Thirst and hunger is replaced by life essence.
Death aura dealing 1 death damage to everything nearby every turn.

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Quarterstaff
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Mask
race.name: Lich

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. They live deep in the jungles of Tar'Var. They are individuals, loners and prefer seclusion over contact with others, as they considering other races untrustworthy. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Strength +1, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Dagger, Shirt
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Dagger
race.name: Rasimi

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Humans were the most common being in the world once, but these days are long gone. The population decimated by constant wars is now just a shadow of its former glory. Representatives of this race are extremely adaptable to the situation, but their history was marked heavily by external influence. As the War of Worlds has ended, a great empire has been formed, where single human family clings to the seat of power to this day.[/color]

All statistics +1
Gets hungry 50% slower

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Knife, Bandage
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Fishing rod
